summary: Add coherent sessions and devices to scenario rosters and launches and launch variants to scenario details, with replay inventory reads and explicit unsupported-route errors

replay.detail: Development and test scenario replay serves session, device, launch and nested launch-variant reads from the same folded inventories as scenario fixtures. Unmodelled routes return an unsupported-capability ErrorEnvelope instead of an empty successful page; no deployed runtime replay change.

schema.detail: No database schema change; scenario inventories use the existing client-v0 Session, Device, Launch and LaunchVariant wire types.

compatibility.detail: Scenario roster state now requires sessions and devices arrays, and details state requires launches and launch_variants arrays. Synthetic worlds and generated fixtures carry these inventories; no deployed client protocol or runtime compatibility change.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; this change affects scenario fixtures and their consumers only.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
